text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, Nike’s most recently completed fiscal year was FY2024, ended May 31, 2024. FY2024 revenue was about $51.2 billion, up roughly 4% from about $49.2 billion in FY2023. Net income was about $5.7 billion, and diluted EPS was about $0.77. Gross margin was around 55%, and operating margin was about 21%. Cash flow remained strong, with operating cash flow above $13 billion and free cash flow above $9 billion in FY2024. In FY2023, revenue was about $49.2 billion, with net income around $5.6 billion and EPS near $0.75. In FY2022, revenue was about $48.3 billion, net income was about $6.3 billion, and EPS was about $0.84. The prior year showed similar margin pressure and cost-driven growth, while FY2024 reflected resilient demand and pricing power. The business has held up better than feared, but growth has slowed from the post-pandemic rebound. The stock’s view: cautiously favorable, though valuation remains rich."}
